name: Pakistan
regionName: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan

indicators.indicator: Political stability and absence of violence

partiesListed.party: Grand Democratic Alliance or GDA (alliance of several parties)
Muttahida Majlis-e-Amal or MMA (alliance of several parties)
Pakistan Tehrik-e Insaaf or PTI (Pakistan Movement for Justice)
Pashtoonkhwa Milli Awami Party or PMAP or PKMAP

profile.languages: Punjabi 38.8%, Pashto (alternate name, Pashtu) 18.2%, Sindhi 14.6%, Saraiki (a Punjabi variant) 12.2%, Urdu 7.1%, Balochi 3%, Hindko 2.4%, Brahui 1.2%, other 2.4%
profile.religions: Muslim 96.4%, Hindu 1.6%, Christian 1.4%; less than 1%: scheduled castes, Qadiani/Ahmadi, other, Sikh. (2020 est.)
profile.legalSystem: common law system with Islamic law influence
profile.nationalHoliday: Pakistan Day, 23 March, also referred to as Pakistan Resolution Day (1940) or Republic Day (1956)
profile.location: Southern Asia, bordering the Arabian Sea, between India on the east and Iran and Afghanistan on the west and China in the north
